blogs.title: 🌍 Medical Tourism Guide for International Patients
blogs.subtitle: Your Complete Guide to Healthcare Travel in India
blogs.introduction: India has become one of the most popular destinations for medical tourism, attracting thousands of international patients every year. The country offers world-class healthcare, advanced technology, highly experienced doctors, and treatment costs that are 60–80% lower compared to the USA, UK, or UAE.

sections.title: ✈️ Why Choose India for Medical Tourism?
points: Top hospitals with international accreditations (JCI, NABH)
Highly qualified doctors trained abroad
Affordable treatment packages (60–80% cheaper)
Availability of advanced technology & robotic surgery
No long waiting times for surgery
English-speaking medical staff & translators available
Rich cultural heritage & recovery-friendly environment

blogs.title: 🏥 What to Expect During Treatment in India
blogs.subtitle: A Step-by-Step Patient Experience Guide
blogs.introduction: For international patients, traveling to another country for medical treatment can feel uncertain. To help you prepare, here’s exactly what you can expect during your medical journey in India — from airport arrival to hospital care and recovery.

sections.title: ✈️ Arrival in India
points: Dedicated team to receive you at the airport
Ground transfers arranged directly to your hotel or hospital
Assistance with currency exchange & SIM card (if required)

sections.title: 🏨 Stay & Accommodation
points: Affordable guest houses, hotels & service apartments near hospitals
Choice of budget, mid-range or luxury stay based on preference
Assistance in booking safe, hygienic accommodations for family members

sections.title: 🏥 Hospital Admission & Treatment Process
points: Doctor Consultation: In-person assessment & confirmation of treatment plan
Pre-Surgery Tests: Lab tests, imaging & medical clearances
Treatment or Surgery: Conducted by expert doctors using advanced technology
Post-Surgery Care: ICU monitoring, regular checkups & physiotherapy

blogs.title: ❓ FAQs About Indian Healthcare for International Patients
blogs.subtitle: Everything You Need to Know Before Traveling to India for Treatment
blogs.introduction: International patients often have many questions before choosing India for treatment. Here are the most frequently asked questions (FAQs) about healthcare, hospitals, costs, and patient services in India.

sections.title: 🏥 Hospitals & Doctors
points: Are Indian hospitals safe? ✔️ Yes, JCI/NABH accredited
Do doctors have global experience? ✔️ Trained in USA/UK/Europe
Will there be language barriers? ✔️ English widely spoken + translators

sections.title: 💰 Costs & Payments
points: Why so affordable? ✔️ 60–80% lower costs
Can I get cost estimate before travel? ✔️ Yes, free estimates available
What payment methods are accepted? ✔️ Credit/debit cards, bank transfer, cash

sections.title: ✈️ Travel & Visa
points: Do I need a visa? ✔️ Yes, Medical Visa (M-Visa)
How long does visa process take? ✔️ 3–5 working days
Can family members travel with me? ✔️ Yes, Medical Attendant Visa available
